beats: A phone dies mid-shift. Or it sits forgotten in a bag. The clock-out time comes out wrong.
Fixing it meant a laptop and the admin panel. On the TV where the family reads the work report, there was no way to touch it.
Now the TV remote edits that end time directly, no login, no laptop.
One more click reverts it back to the original GPS time.
Five new tests cover the edit and every rejection case, reaching back 62 days.
